N-add16#1.t: Huh... something's not right up ahead. Careful, everyone!

N-add16#2.zh: 哈哈！竟能看穿我们的埋伏，看来你们不是普通人。
N-add16#2.t: Haha! You saw through our ambush. You're no ordinary folk, it seems.

N-add16#3.zh: 你们这些小毛贼连洒家也敢抢，真是活得不耐烦了！
N-add16#3.t: You petty thieves dare to rob me? You must be tired of living!

N-add16#4.zh: 哼哼...我知你们并非泛泛之辈，但是你们也不要小看了我，我手下的人数是你们的十倍以上；诸位都是不得了的英雄好汉，劝你们还是乖乖听话的好，不要枉自送了性命！
N-add16#4.t: Heh heh... I know you're no common lot, but don't underestimate me either. I've more than ten times your numbers. You're all remarkable heroes, so I'd advise you to do as you're told and not throw your lives away!

N-add16#5.zh: 俺长那么大了还不知道听话两字怎写！
N-add16#5.t: I've grown this big and still don't know how to write 'do as you're told'!

N-add16#6.zh: 多说无益，如果各位坚持不肯放行的话，那么咱们只好强行突破了！
N-add16#6.t: Talk is useless. If you insist on not letting us pass, we'll just have to force our way through!

N-add16#8.zh: 胜利条件   --- %N到达撤退区域

N-add16#10.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N-add16#11.zh: 众人且战且走，眼见同伴一一死亡，人心涣散，梁山泊前平添好汉荒冢，无人过问........
N-add16#11.t: They fought as they went, watching their companions die one by one until their spirit broke. A few more heroes' graves lay before Liangshan Marsh, untended........
